title: Computationally efficient safe exploration in reinforcement learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.22919v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning in real-life applications requires safety guarantees during exploration. Typical reinforcement learning algorithms do not provide such guarantees, and many modifications that do rely on Gaussian processes (GPs), which have a large computational cost. We propose a computationally lightweight algorithm based on the Nadaraya-Watson estimator that safely explores and optimizes constrained Markov decision processes (MDPs). Our algorithm, \textsc{CoLSafe-MDP}, uses an estimator that scales in constant-time with bounds on the estimates, a significant improvement from its GP-based counterparts that scale cubically with the number of data points. We then evaluate its performance in a grid-based environment and on observational Martian terrain data.

translated_title: 强化学习中计算高效的安全探索
translated_abstract: 强化学习在现实应用中需要在探索过程中提供安全保证。典型的强化学习算法无法提供此类保证，而许多能够提供安全保证的改进方法依赖于高斯过程（GP），其计算成本高昂。我们提出了一种基于 Nadaraya-Watson 估计器的计算轻量级算法，可安全地探索并优化受限马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。我们的算法 CoLSafe-MDP 使用一种以常数时间扩展且带有估计值边界的估计器，相较于随数据点数量呈立方级扩展的基于高斯过程的方法，这是一个显著的改进。随后，我们在基于网格的环境中以及观测到的火星地形数据上评估了该算法的性能。
tldr: 提出基于Nadaraya-Watson估计器的CoLSafe-MDP算法，以常数时间复杂度实现强化学习中的安全探索，相比基于高斯过程的方法大幅降低了计算成本。
en_tdlr: Proposes CoLSafe-MDP, a Nadaraya-Watson estimator-based algorithm that achieves safe exploration in reinforcement learning with constant-time computational cost, significantly outperforming Gaussian process-based methods that scale cubically with data points.
